items.headline: Preston Stout NCAA Lead
items.text: Oklahoma State junior Preston Stout leads the NCAA Championship at 11-under after a third-round 65, putting him on track to potentially earn a 2027 Masters invitation.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Korea
items.text: Joaquin Niemann birdied the first playoff hole against Talor Gooch to claim LIV Golf Korea, his first LIV title of 2026 and eighth overall, finishing at 12-under 268.
